## Release — backlog-campaign v0.35.0

### ✨ What's new in v0.35.0

#### Features

- feat(release): cadence-primary release policy with early cut ([#1504](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1504))
- feat(release): cut a release every 10 merged PRs, on by default ([#1516](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1516))
- feat(pareto): one scale, body-line parser and stored-priority batch order ([#1527](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1527))
- feat(pareto): every filing site writes the Pareto line and label ([#1533](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1533))

#### Fixes

- fix(campaign-status): skip cross-repo queue keys instead of NaN ([#1524](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1524))
- fix(carry): honour docs_governance kill switch in carry-staged-artifacts ([#1525](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1525))
- fix(queue): user_queue_order holds only owner pins; ingest stops appending ([#1532](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1532))
- fix(stack): concurrent ADR PRs adding rows to decisions/INDEX.md are no V-STACK-02 overlap ([#1548](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1548))

#### Other

- chore(release): v0.34.0 ([#1498](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1498))
- perf(reviewer): load mechanically gated audit modules on demand (part of #1387) ([#1544](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1544))
